description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing a collection of photos, including a PhotosService class with stubbed methods for fetching, uploading, and sharing photos, as well as seed data for initial photos. It also exports hooks for consuming the context.

classes.name: PhotosService
classes.description: Provides stubbed methods for fetching, uploading, and generating share URLs for photos, intended for future backend integration.

methods.name: fetchPhotos
methods.description: Stub method to fetch all photos, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: uploadPhoto
methods.description: Stub method to upload a photo, currently echoes back the input photo.

methods.name: getShareUrl
methods.description: Generates a shareable URL route for a given photo ID.

methods.name: PhotosProvider
methods.description: React component that manages photo state, provides CRUD operations, and seeds initial data.

methods.name: usePhotos
methods.description: Custom hook to access the Photos context.
